patches_removed.name: Fix screen freeze
patches_removed.description: Fixes screen freezing after resuming the app from the background.

patches_modified.name: Disable Play Integrity
patches_modified.description: Short-circuits the Google Play Integrity attestation request with a "DISABLED" response, avoiding failures on modified or non-Play builds.

patches_modified.name: Disable developer options detection
patches_modified.description: Stops the app from detecting that Developer Options or USB debugging are enabled on the device, removing the blocking security dialog.

patches_modified.name: Disable root & emulator detection
patches_modified.description: Forces every root, jailbreak, emulator and frida check in the app to report a clean device, so no blocking dialog is shown on modified/rooted environments.

patches_modified.name: Remove CleverTap tracking
patches_modified.description: Removes CleverTap analytics initialization, stopping the app from collecting the phone number as an identity key and from reporting usage data.

patches_removed.name: Galaxy XR recommended set (2.0.22/5002318)
patches_removed.description: Applies the 9-patch Galaxy XR set for exact Steam Link 2.0.22 build 5002318, including separately listed startup permissions and splash/XR launch mode.

patches_removed.name: Galaxy XR recommended set (2.0.22/5002322)
patches_removed.description: Applies the 6-patch Galaxy XR set for exact Steam Link 2.0.22 build 5002322. Preserves stock startup and permission requests except battery settings; includes the Final balanced tested OLED profile.

patches_modified.name: Device identity
patches_modified.description: Overrides the HMD identity reported to SteamVR. Recommended selects Meta Quest Pro for exact legacy bundle targets through 5002244, including 2.0.20/5001712; otherwise Galaxy XR. The Galaxy profile installs its complete transport identity while preserving stock controller/hand routing and extensions. Optional on 2.0.23/5002363; explicit Quest Pro and Pico profiles populate exact Galaxy XR product entries.

patches_modified.name: Force HMD initialization gates
patches_modified.description: Bypasses the two verified capability gates in QSVLDeviceHmd::Init for Steam Link builds 5001712 and 5002244.

patches_modified.name: Force lobby permission-state gate
patches_modified.description: Bypasses the verified permission-state gate in XrSceneLobby for Steam Link builds 5001712 and 5002244.

patches_modified.name: Force stream XR gates
patches_modified.description: Bypasses the three verified XR gates in builds 5001712 and 5002244.

patches_modified.name: GXR tongue bridge (version 5002322 and above)
patches_modified.description: For exact Steam Link 2.0.23/5002363 with Valve's native Android XR face mapping and its independently verified native layout. Preserves Valve's face expressions and standard TongueOut while exposing Galaxy XR tongue out/left/right/up/down to the matching Galaxy XR VRCFT module.

patches_modified.name: Galaxy XR high-resolution 3-projection fix
patches_modified.description: Permission-free resolution fix for exact builds 5001712, 5002244, and 5002363. Preserves each build's native projection layout (2 layers on 2.0.20/5001712; 3 layers on supported 2.0.22 and 2.0.23 builds) and source formats, including future RGB10_A2, while appending a static 2x2 Android-surface compositor trigger with no image copy or reconstruction.

patches_modified.name: Galaxy XR legacy foundation (through 2.0.22/5002244)
patches_modified.description: Selects the 17-patch Galaxy XR legacy set, including Meta Quest Pro identity, native gates, face bridge, OLED calibration, microphone, battery, Visual Delay, explicit startup permissions and splash, and XR foundation. High-resolution output is guarded to verified layouts.

patches_modified.name: OLED color calibration
patches_modified.description: OLED calibration with optional VD-informed SDR foveal processing for 8-bit or 10-bit input, always with 8-bit sRGB output. The VD options remove added gamma/saturation and arithmetic noise from the foveal shader while retaining Valve's decoder colour correction. Exact builds 5001712, 5002244, and 5002363; decoder precision and banding improvement require runtime verification.

patches_added.name: [Reels] Download any reel
patches_added.description: Adds a Download button beside every reel, and not only the reels that you posted. It saves the video the player is streaming, at the best quality the player holds, to Movies/Facebook.

patches_modified.name: [Stories] Download any story
patches_modified.description: Adds a save option to the menu of any story, and not only to the stories that you posted. It saves the picture or the video that the story shows, including a story with music, which Facebook's own save refuses. Files go to Pictures/Facebook or Movies/Facebook.
